report.summary: All three failures are one cause: every /books render (including the redirect after login, register, and delete) runs list_books, which sleeps random.uniform(0, 8) seconds in app/main.py:150. Whenever that sleep exceeds the 5 s Playwright timeout set in tests/conftest.py, the test fails, so these are flaky, not product bugs. First step: remove or pin that random sleep in app/main.py (or gate it behind an env var that tests leave off), then rerun the UI suite several times to confirm it is stable.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s server delay in list_books makes UI navigations exceed the 5 s timeout
causes.explanation: app/main.py:150 calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) on every list_books call. list_books is called from render_books (app/main.py:256), which serves GET /books, and the redirect targets after POST /register, POST /books/{id}/delete and POST /books all land there. The sleep is uniform over 0-8 s, so roughly 3/8 of page renders take longer than 5 s. The test suite sets page.set_default_timeout(5000) (tests/conftest.py:7), so those renders time out. The failing steps are: (1) page.goto('/books') waiting for the 'load' event, which waits for the slow server response; (2) the delete click, where Playwright waits for the scheduled navigation to /books to finish after the 303 redirect; (3) the register submit click, which likewise waits for the navigation to /books. The same code can pass on a rerun, which matches the nondeterministic pattern: test_added_book_is_listed and test_existing_user_can_log_in also load /books and passed in this run. The randomness lives in the app, but the outcome depends on timing, so this is classified as flaky.
evidence: test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui: playwright._impl._errors.TimeoutError: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:51139/books", waiting until "load"
test_deleted_book_disappears: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. ... click action done / waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (the delete click redirects to /books via app/main.py:346)

test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. ... click action done (get_by_test_id("submit") on /register; register_submit redirects to /books via app/main.py:297 and logged_in_redirect)
tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:9 and tests/support/pages.py:22 show the submit click that timed out
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books in app/main.py, since it is not needed for behavior. If the latency is meant to exist for testing, make it opt-in via an env var that CI does not set, or use a fixed value well under 5 s. Do not just raise the timeout, because the 5 s limit in conftest.py is intentional. After that, rerun the ui suite a few times to confirm it passes consistently.
